issues: Potential bug in `src/lib/categories.ts`: the `renameCategory` implementation does not correctly handle updates when the new name already exists in a case‑insensitive manner for default categories that have been renamed. The conflict check uses `effectiveNames` which already includes renamed defaults, but the special case allowing rename to same name with different case only checks the original default name mapping (`data.rename[defaultMatch]`). This can cause a duplicate rename to pass when it shouldn't, violating requirement R6 (no side‑effects on failed rename). Also, `isCategoryInUse` may return incorrect results when called with only a name after a rename because it falls back to `getStore()` which may not be initialized in tests, leading to possible false negatives for R5.

The UI requirements R8–R20 are not covered by the current code base: components like `BottomActionBar` do not include FABs for receipt and mileage, the receipt entry screen title appears multiple times (the `Screen` component already renders a title and there is a duplicate `<ScreenHeader>`), and the Settings screen still uses outlined buttons instead of switch rows and simple list items, which violates R18–R20.

The `validateMileageMiles` function in `src/lib/validation.ts` currently rejects numeric inputs with more than one decimal place using a regex that also rejects numbers like `12` without a decimal point (due to missing anchor for integer-only values). This can cause valid integer mileages to be incorrectly flagged, violating requirement R7.

The `MileageEntryScreen` calculates the deduction based on `milesNumber` which is parsed from the string, but the UI `FormField` for miles accepts only numeric input (`keyboardType="decimal-pad"`). It does not handle string inputs correctly when a user types a value like "12.5", causing the validation to never be triggered for string values, violating requirement R8.
review.feedback: The current implementation passes the acceptance test suite but fails to meet many of the listed UI and logic requirements. Category renaming does not fully enforce duplicate‑name protection and `isCategoryInUse` may not work correctly when called without a store. Mileage validation and UI handling of decimal mileage are incomplete, and several UI components (FAB placement, screen titles, Settings rows) still use the old design. Update the code to fully satisfy all R1‑R20 requirements, add proper conflict handling in `renameCategory`, fix `validateMileageMiles` regex to accept integer values, adjust `MileageEntryScreen` to handle string inputs and display errors, and revamp the UI components to match the new design specs. Once these changes are made and the relevant tests are added/updated, the solution should be re‑run.
